description: A closed, hazard-striped firelock door with a lit warning indicator beside it. The door's own panel visibly changes (darkens, as it starts moving) while the warning indicator keeps glowing exactly as before, never turning off in step with the door.
reproduces: https://github.com/space-wizards/space-station-14/issues/36889 and the PR's own test plan (https://github.com/space-wizards/space-station-14/pull/46007): enclose a space with a firelock, arm its pressure/temperature warning, then open it
scenario: Real Saltern station (Resources/Maps/saltern.yml) with a real Firelock entity (prototype 'Firelock') closed and alarmed. An admin observer watches the firelock: its panel starts moving (darkening, no longer the steady closed look) while the small warning indicator beside it keeps glowing exactly as it did when closed, unmoved by the door's own change.
